key_catalyst: U.S. strikes Iran for ninth consecutive night, pushing Brent crude above $90 and 30-year yields over 5%
reasoning: The pre-market is shrugging off a severe escalation in the U.S.-Iran conflict (ninth consecutive night of strikes, oil above $90) that has pushed the 30-year Treasury yield over 5% and reignited September rate-hike expectations. While earnings anticipation and an oversold bounce in semiconductors are driving a tactical rally, these massive macro headwinds for long-duration tech multiples are unresolved and escalating, making the current bounce highly vulnerable to a reality check during the session.
